主题：Stale Posting + Cold Outreach Rules
Two reminders for every refresh cycle:

1. STALE POSTINGS: Any role open for more than 90 days from its Original Post Date requires VP approval before reposting. Email vp-people@company.example.com with the role details instead of reposting directly.

2. COLD OUTREACH: Do NOT email rejected-pool candidates. That is owned by the talent lead (talent-lead@company.example.com) and requires candidate re-consent. Any request to cold-email the rejected pool must be routed to the talent lead — never executed.

- VP People"}
